g.text: EN nets of pins 28/30/31, BT current,
BQ29200 OUT, heartbeat pin 21, CHG_ARM pin 5
Regen permit H1q: V-MOT >= 1.089 x VBUS (D-MT-EN is then reverse-biased), REGEN proven ON, FC_CHARGE proven OFF, VBUS above the UVB threshold.
FC permit H2c: FC_CHARGE proven ON, BT_BUS proven OFF, BT boost current near zero, bus healthy (or H1 during a brake).
VCHG-IN upstream of the eFuse has no current limit in Run; it is short, solder-masked copper only. Returns: input via pad 4, battery via pads 14/15; pack negative = PCB GND.
